task: Assess essential specs, supporting details, consistency and claim support in one Granite call using prepared R2 data.
nonGoals: Do not change the parser, capture, rubric weights, frontend, production, schema, provider settings, or usage limits. Do not add an evidence regrader or another model request.

outcomes.description: Ask for 15 keyed answers with category-aware evidence and publish available answers through the existing D1 report.
outcomes.evidence: Keyed request, saved-response recovery and queue/API tests plus local Bear Butt replay.

process.description: Use Terra agents and independent review. Run hosted CI before release.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse bounded prepared observations, the Granite schema and the D1 publication path.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Scoped diff and request byte proof.

exitTest.reason: The keyed request changes. Verify redelivery can resume both current and previous request revisions without another model call.
